verdict.rationale: MX documents separate connectivity products with distinct data payloads: Instant Account Verification for account and routing numbers only, Account Owner Identification for name and address, Account Aggregation for 90 days, and Extended Transaction History for 24 months. This implies a developer can choose narrower data products rather than taking an all-or-nothing pull. However, nothing in the pack describes product-scoped end-user consent or explicit data-minimization controls. missing for 10: documented per-product or per-scope consent grants, explicit data-minimization or scope-restriction controls, consent revocation or scope management docs, independent corroboration.
